scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,report,extension -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @alexa-auditor/server" "npm run dev -w @alexa-auditor/report" "npm run dev -w @alexa-auditor/extension"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @alexa-auditor/contracts && npm run build -w @alexa-auditor/report && npm run build -w @alexa-auditor/server && npm run build -w @alexa-auditor/extension
scripts.test: npm run test -w @alexa-auditor/contracts && npm run test -w @alexa-auditor/server && npm run test -w @alexa-auditor/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @alexa-auditor/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @alexa-auditor/server && npm run typecheck -w @alexa-auditor/report && npm run typecheck -w @alexa-auditor/extension
scripts.release:check: npm run version:check && npm run docs:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run version:check && npm run docs:check
